questions.question: When was the colonoscopy referral first made, and what was the clinical indication?
Has the patient had any gastrointestinal symptoms such as bleeding, change in bowel habit or abdominal pain that led to the colonoscopy referral?
Was a bowel preparation plan or instructions provided for the colonoscopy, and when?
Have any diagnostic test results (e.g., FIT, colonoscopy report, imaging) been recorded that relate to the referral?
Has the patient been assessed for colonoscopy contraindications or risks (e.g., anticoagulants, comorbidities)?
Was the colonoscopy referral discussed with or approved by a consultant or specialist, and when?
